sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Wind Release, Clash

system.description:
You conjure a large Tiger made of snow or ice and begins to rush at a target creature. If there is any Water or Water Release Jutsu in between you and the target creature, it immediately freezes, dispelling the jutsu, if any. If this jutsu would Clash with a jutsu with the water release keyword, that jutsu is immediately dispelled.

Creatures submerged within Water or gaining the benefits of a Water Release jutsu with a range of Self must make a Dexterity save, gaining 2 ranks of Frostbite on a failed save.

Upon reaching the target, the ice tiger explodes firing ice shards in a 15-foot radius centering on the target. All creatures in the radius must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 8d6 cold damage on a failed save or half as much damage and no further effects on a successful save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
